description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Cost and Reliability Score for three different modeling approaches: 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis is labeled "Cost" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 20 and corresponding horizontal grid lines. The plot contains three solid lines, all of which use circular markers at data points corresponding to x-axis values of 0, 5, and 10. The "3-Model Ensemble" is represented by a blue line that shows a slight, steady decline, starting at a Reliability Score of approximately 82 at a Cost of 0, passing through approximately 79 at a Cost of 5, and ending at approximately 75 at a Cost of 10. The "2-Model Ensemble" is depicted by a red line that also exhibits a steady decline, beginning at approximately 85 at a Cost of 0, intersecting the blue line at approximately 79 at a Cost of 5, and concluding at approximately 73 at a Cost of 10. Finally, the "GPT-4" approach is shown as a yellow line that demonstrates a steep, continuous decline across the x-axis, starting at a high of approximately 89 at a Cost of 0, dropping to approximately 65 at a Cost of 5, and finishing at a low of approximately 41 at a Cost of 10.
